title: Switch configs
intro: Back up the running config of the switches and see what changed during the event. Passwords, keys and SNMP communities are taken out before a copy is kept; the last {{keep}} copies per switch are kept.
noPlugin: No plugin that can run switch commands is on. An admin turns on SSH port actions under Settings > Plugins.
passwordHint: Used for this backup only, never stored.
nightlyNoLogin: Floorbit backs up every switch at night once a switch login is stored.
nightly_one: Every night at {{hour}}:00 Floorbit backs up {{count}} switch with the stored login.
nightly_other: Every night at {{hour}}:00 Floorbit backs up {{count}} switches with the stored logins.
nightlyLast: Last nightly run {{when}}: {{ok}} of {{total}} backed up, {{changed}} changed.

portCheck.title: Seat port check
portCheck.intro: Read from each switch's last config copy, no login needed: every seat port should come up at once (PortFast), shut itself when a player plugs in a switch (BPDU guard), stop a broadcast flood (storm control), be an access port, and sit in the same VLAN as its neighbours. Checked again after every backup.

portCheck.summary_other: {{count}} switches with seat ports checked, {{fine}} fine.
